data.title: Siebert projects Strategy could acquire 190,000 Bitcoin by Q3 2027
data.description: Strategy already holds more Bitcoin than any other public company. Siebert Financial thinks it is nowhere near done.Siebert analyst Brian Vieten projects that Strategy could own approximately 1.04 million Bitcoin by the third quarter of 2027. He also reaffirmed his Buy rating and $350 price target…
